data.long_description:
Apartment for Sale in Symphony On The Park, Town Square Dubai

Provident Real Estate Broker LLC – Business Bay Branch is pleased to present this exceptional two-bedroom corner apartment in Symphony On The Park, located within the vibrant master community of Town Square Dubai.

Offered for sale at AED 1,550,000, this high-floor residence combines modern design, functional living spaces, and serene open views, creating an ideal home for both end-users and investors. Positioned as a corner unit, the apartment benefits from enhanced privacy, abundant natural light, and unobstructed views overlooking the pool and surrounding community landscapes.

The interiors are thoughtfully designed with spacious bedrooms, built-in wardrobes, and a fully fitted kitchen equipped with modern appliances. A dedicated laundry room and private balcony further enhance convenience and everyday comfort.

Property Features:

2 Spacious Bedrooms
High-floor corner unit
Built-in wardrobes
Dedicated laundry room
Fully fitted kitchen with appliances
Private balcony
Open pool and community views

Community Amenities:

Direct access to Central Park
Resort-style swimming pool
Fully equipped fitness center
Landscaped gardens and open spaces
Children’s play areas
Jogging and cycling tracks
Retail outlets and dining options
Family-friendly gated environment
24/7 security services

Symphony On The Park offers a lifestyle centered around greenery, wellness, and community living. Residents enjoy a peaceful suburban atmosphere while remaining well connected to key destinations across Dubai, making Town Square one of the city’s most attractive communities for modern family living and long-term investment potential.
